headline: Portfolio Outperformance Against SPY YTD
summary: As of August 17, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 25.98% compared to SPY's 14.03%. This 11.96% alpha indicates that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a remarkable return of 47.85%, significantly contributing to the overall outperformance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 18.91%, which still reflects a positive performance relative to SPY. This outperformance is particularly notable during periods of market stress and uncertainty, reinforcing the portfolio's strength in a challenging environment. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
